text.trigger: A player controls Sparky and is not exiled.
text.vignette: Sparky's old trainer kept a barn full of props: pulleys, harnesses, and a gun made for a very patient dog. With a little tinkering, the whole thing might do something no dog has ever done.

options.pull-the-string: Sparky takes out 8 zombies at the colony; nobody rolls exposure.
options.show-him-off: Everyone gets a laugh out of the rigged-up dog: morale rises by 1.
